svg.title: C — Modular Sitka groundcover and Unity art kit
svg.desc: Editable visual specification of a modular ground material stack, needle decals, sparse moss and woody scatter, blending boundaries, human-scale inspection and proposed LOD priorities. Not a Unity asset.
svg.text: CCF / ORIGINAL TEXT-SVG / ASSET ARCHITECTURE CONCEPT
Preserve #786 continuous flat plane and its atlas. Material/shader composition is a proposed later step.
• Reuse #786 atlas/mesh; add layered roughness & macro colour
• 2–3 needle microdetails + small restrained moss areas
• Tree-foot soft variation; inspect path/planting seams
Candidate only — optimise after measuring actual scene
• Sparse fern/grass clumps only where visuals support
• Detail LOD/culling tuned from instrumented GPU frames
No dynamic canopy/ecology rules without separate approval
EYE HEIGHT 1–5 m: fine silhouettes + roughness • MID 5–20 m: broad tonal mosaic • TOP-DOWN: uninterrupted H1/path/G1 boundaries
All scales, cutoffs and layer counts are design proposals. Existing simulation, meshes, world identity and save bytes remain authoritative.
